n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: The second cabinet. At night the corridor is empty and the Chamber is yours.

go.speaker: narrator
go.text: It rolls on a worn castor. Behind it: a low door, and candlelight.

day.speaker: narrator
day.text: A cabinet of precedent. Heavy. One castor is worn shiny, as if it is often moved. Not with the corridor this busy.
